08_ch13_15.html line ~294 (FAQ, not my file) still only says 'run voicetwin.bat download-models' via 3.6. That still works (3.6 方法二), but the FAQ could also mention the 🩺 环境检查 → ⬇️ 下载缺少的模型 button.
I used 00_gpu_badge.png in chapter 2 (图 2-1). If the chapter 5 owner also shows the badge, the same picture will appear twice. They could reference 图 2-1 or use 01_prepare_form.png instead.

problems_fixed: <仓库>/docs/manual/src/01_cover.html: the cover said "40 多个常见问题的解决办法", but chapter 15 in 08_ch13_15.html has 56 Q&A entries. Changed it to "50 多个常见问题的解决办法".

<仓库>/docs/manual/src/02_ch01_02.html, 1.2 table, 多候选择优 row: it said every tier redoes sentences with missing or wrong words. In engine.py QUALITY_PRESETS, fast and balanced have asr=False, so only 最好 and higher check with speech recognition. The row now says "「最好」及更高的档位还会用语音识别检查，发现漏字、读错会自动重做".

<仓库>/docs/manual/src/02_ch01_02.html, 1.4 note: yellow was described as "好几分钟没有新进度". Changed it to "3 分钟以上没有新进度", matching STALL_SECONDS=180 in utils/progress.py and chapter 5.3. Added "（详见 5.3 节）" (5.3 看懂进度条 has the full legend).

<仓库>/docs/manual/src/02_ch01_02.html, 1.5 glossary, 像你本人（%）row: it said candidates below 85% are always eliminated, which contradicts 1.2 and 1.3. Elimination only happens when a reliable speaker model is available (similarity.filter auto, engine.sim_filter). The row now says "有可靠的声纹模型时，低于 85% 的候选会被淘汰".
remaining_concerns: Image 10_doctor.png (图 3-1) was captured on Linux. Its ffmpeg row shows the full sandbox path <会话临时目录> which contains the word "claude" and goes against the no AI-tool attribution rule. It also shows Python 3.9.23 (Linux x86_64), and faster-whisper / resemblyzer as ⚠️ 未安装, which a real Windows install does not have. The caption does say the paths and versions are examples, but the screenshot should be retaken or the path cropped/blurred. I did not change it because I am not allowed to edit image files.

Section 2.6 still says the VoiceTwin zip is "约 20MB". The updater's summary said it changed this to "十几 MB", but that edit is not in the file. I estimate the zip at about 18 MB or more (manual PDF 13 MB, QuickStart PDF 2.4 MB, guide HTML with embedded images about 2 MB, code about 1 MB), and it will grow as the manual PDF grows. So "约 20MB" is accurate and I left it.

快速上手.md (not my file) still has upgrade step ③ and install step 4 saying "安装完成". The real installer prints "✅ 安装成功！…" and then asks "现在就打开声音分身吗？". Chapters 3.4 and 3.9 now match the installer, so the quick start is out of step with the manual.

Section 3.7's note says you copy text from the black window by selecting it with the mouse and pressing Enter. In v0.1.6 every voicetwin command except init-config and doctor turns off QuickEdit (cli._disable_quick_edit) and never turns it back on, so mouse selection may not work while a command is running, or after one in that window. This text predates this edit and I left it, but someone should check it on Windows.

Everything else checked out against the code. Each tab and button name in these files matches app.py exactly: ① 准备素材, ④ 试试像不像（可选）, ⑤ 鉴别, 🩺 环境检查, 🔄 重新检查显卡, ⬇️ 下载缺少的模型, 🔄 重新检查（约 10~30 秒）, 开始准备素材. The installer console examples in 3.4 and 3.9 match install_windows.ps1 and cli.py, including the 18-row doctor numbering. The quality-tier defaults and the 85% rule match engine.py and default_config.yaml. No v0.1.3-only UI is left, nothing promises 100% identical voice, and nothing suggests adding background sound. Both referenced images exist, figure numbers are sequential (图 2-1, 图 3-1), and all four files have balanced HTML tags. Cross-references to chapters 5, 7, 9, 12, 13, 13.3, 15, 15.1 and appendices A and B point to existing headings.

update.summary:
I updated both files I own for v0.1.6. Every button, label and message text I wrote was checked against voicetwin/webui/app.py, plus launcher.py, utils/gpu.py, utils/progress.py, workflows.py, errors.py and the installer where relevant. CLI and config facts were checked against cli.py and default_config.yaml. No git commands were run and the PDF was not built.

**04_ch04_05.html**
- Ch4 is unchanged except one fix: the background-music option in 4.6 now has its exact label, "视频有背景音乐（去除背景音乐，会慢一些）".
- 5.1 Start program: the black-window example now shows what the program really prints (the start_webui.bat line and the "v0.1.6 正在启动 / 网页地址" banner). Added:
  - Double-clicking the icon again opens the running page instead of a second copy.
  - If port 7860 is busy the program picks another port; use the address shown in the black window.
  - The black window's quick-edit mode is turned off; if the title shows "选择", press Enter.
  - The PC is kept awake during long tasks.
- 5.2 Interface overview:
  - Figure 5-1 (01_prepare_form.png) with a top-to-bottom table: title with version, GPU bar, voice name with "🔄 刷新声音列表" and the status line, "🎙️ 我的声音库（共 N 个）", the six tabs, and the "详细过程" log section.
  - New sub-part on the GPU bar: Figure 5-2 (00_gpu_badge.png) and a green/yellow/red table, including the driver link, the nvidia50 package and "🔄 重新检查显卡".
  - New sub-part on the voice library: Figure 5-3 (00b_voice_library.png), its columns, and click-a-row-to-select.
- 5.3 Progress bar (new section, id ch5-3):
  - Figure 5-4 (02a_progress_running.png) with a table explaining each line on the bar.
  - Figure 5-5 (11_progress_states.png) with a table of the five colours. Yellow means no progress for 3 minutes or more, and the time estimate shows "暂时算不出来".
  - Stopping needs two clicks within 5 seconds. Closing or refreshing the page does not stop the task. Only one task runs at a time.
  - Red bar: Figure 5-6 (09_error_red.png). Follow 原因/怎么办; to ask for help, copy the "详细过程（出问题时可以复制给帮你的人）" text.
- 5.4 Close and reopen: this was 5.3 and its id is now ch5-4. It also mentions picking the voice from the voice library.

**05_ch06_07.html**
- 6.1 / 6.2: exact labels, the status line under the voice name, and the voice-library tip.
- 6.3: the options table now uses the real names. The background-music checkbox is on the page; under "高级设置（一般不用改）" are 识别文字用哪个引擎, 素材语言 and 降噪, with their Chinese choices.
- 6.4 is now "开始处理，看进度条". The old log table is replaced by the 7 real prepare steps; an 8th "查找可能的错字" step runs automatically if a second recognition engine is installed. After it finishes you get the 100% bar, the summary, the "去「② 训练模型」 →" button, and the clip table loads by itself. Figure 6-1 is 02_prepare_done.png with a new caption. A note covers the yellow bar during the first model download and the log section.
- 6.5: the summary table follows the new wording (minutes per language, auto-removed reasons, speech rate, pause habits, 20 test clips, reference recordings). Added the "📊 一共 228 条片段：保留 228 条（16.4 分钟），不保留 0 条" total line and a warning row for files that could not be processed. The discard-reason table now uses 是/否.
- 7.2 rewritten for the typo finder, with Figure 7-1 (03a_proofcheck_done.png) and Figure 7-2 (03_proofread.png). It covers:
  - the "🔍 自动查找可能的错字" button and how it works, including the fallbacks when no second engine is installed;
  - "只看可能有错的" and the 8-column table;
  - clicking a row to play it and see the comparison box (识别 A / 识别 B);
  - "✅ 采用建议", double-click to edit 文字, 保留 是/否, and "保存修改" with its real result message;
  - the unsaved-changes reminder, and a warning that "🔄 重新载入" throws away unsaved edits.
  The Figure 7-2 caption explains that the demo machine had no second engine, so there is no suggestion. The old "载入片段列表" button and ✔/✘ wording are gone.
- 7.3 Excel route: save as CSV, close Excel/WPS, run `voicetwin.bat review -v 我的声音`, then click "🔄 重新载入". A warning says not to click 保存修改 in the web page before running review.

Figures are numbered 5-1 to 5-6, 6-1, 7-1 and 7-2. All referenced images exist, both HTML files have balanced tags, and there are no duplicate ids.
open_questions: The Excel route in docs/Windows详细使用教程.md (step 8, the Excel tip) is wrong and loses edits. It says to close Excel and click 🔄 重新载入, but that button (load_clips in voicetwin/webui/app.py) only re-reads manifest.jsonl and never imports transcripts.csv. Only the CLI command `voicetwin review` (via apply_review/import_csv) reads the CSV back. 保存修改 also calls apply_review, but it first writes the web table over the CSV, so Excel edits are lost if it is clicked before running review. I wrote 7.3 as: run `voicetwin.bat review -v 我的声音`, then click 🔄 重新载入. Either fix the Windows guide, or make 🔄 重新载入 import the CSV.

08_ch13_15.html line 203 says the Excel edits can be read back by clicking a button in the web page as well as by the command line. No web button imports the CSV without first overwriting it, so that sentence needs the owner of that file to correct it.

Section numbers changed: the new progress-bar section is 5.3 (id ch5-3), and 关闭程序与下次打开 moved to 5.4 (id ch5-4). Chapters 8 and 9 (for example 8.3 看懂训练日志) can point to 5.3 for the bar colours and the stop button instead of repeating them. No other file linked to the old #ch5-3.

problems_fixed: 04_ch04_05.html, 5.3 "停止任务、关掉网页": the manual said the progress bar comes back by itself when you reopen the page. It does not. on_load in app.py only shows the top banner from task_banner_md ("🔄 后台正在「…」…到「tab」页点「button」可以接着看进度，不会重新开始"), and _attaching only reconnects when the same button is clicked again. Rewrote the bullet to say this.

04_ch04_05.html, 5.3 table under Figure 5-4: the example line now matches the real meta line and the screenshot, "第 3 / 3 个文件 · 已用 50 秒 · 这一步不到 1 分钟就好". Its explanation now covers the counter too (which file, clip or sentence).

04_ch04_05.html, 5.2 GPU bar table, red row: the manual told users to click 🔄 重新检查显卡 straight after installing the driver. The real advice in utils/gpu.py ADVICE_DRIVER is to reboot and then reopen 声音分身. Reworded to: reboot, reopen the program, check the bar is green, and optionally click 🔄 重新检查显卡.

05_ch06_07.html, 7.3 Excel warning: it only warned against 保存修改. The "✅ 采用建议" button also rewrites transcripts.csv (Project.set_clip_text calls export_csv), so unimported Excel edits are lost there too. The warning now names both buttons.

05_ch06_07.html, 6.5: the clip-count line only changes after saving, because only do_save returns _clips_count_md. The text now says it updates after clicking "保存修改", not as soon as the table is edited.
remaining_concerns: docs/Windows详细使用教程.md line 274 is still wrong, and it is outside my files. It says to close Excel and click "🔄 重新载入", but load_clips only re-reads manifest.jsonl and never imports the CSV, so the Excel edits never reach the program. The guide should say to run `voicetwin.bat review -v 我的声音` first. Chapter 7.3 of the manual and 08_ch13_15.html 14.5 already say this; the line-203 sentence the updater flagged in 08_ch13_15.html seems to be gone already.

docs/Windows详细使用教程.md line 223 has the same mistake I fixed in 5.3. It says "重新打开网页后，进度条会接着显示", but you actually have to click the same start button again on the page the top banner names. It needs the same correction (outside my files).

Other checks found no problems. Every label, button, tab and table header checked matches app.py, utils/gpu.py, utils/progress.py, launcher.py and the installer, including CLIP_HEADERS, LIB_HEADERS, the 7 prepare steps plus the optional 8th, the summary lines, prepare warnings and drop reasons. The voice-name character rule and the CSV columns are correct, and `review -v` exists in cli.py. No leftover v0.1.3 UI, no promise of 100% identical voice, no room-tone wording. All 9 referenced images exist, figures run 5-1 to 5-6, 6-1, 7-1 and 7-2, tags are balanced, and there are no duplicate ids.

One thing for the developers, not a manual error: with "只看可能有错的" ticked, 保存修改 writes only the filtered rows to transcripts.csv, and apply_review then re-exports the full CSV. That looks safe because import_csv skips missing ids, but if a user has unimported Excel edits, rows that are not visible are overwritten silently.

update.summary:
I updated chapters 8–12 of the manual for v0.1.6. I edited only 06_ch08_09.html and 07_ch10_12.html. All heading ids and section numbers stay the same, so links from other chapters (9.2, 9.5, 8.7, 10.x, 11.3) still work. The HTML tags are balanced and all 13 images I reference are in docs/manual/images. Every UI label inside .ui/.btn/.tab spans matches app.py; the only exceptions are Windows, Notepad and 剪映 menu names, which are not in the app.

**Ch8 (training)**
- 8.2: the steps now follow the real screens, with 图 8-1 (the training plan shown before you start), 图 8-2 (progress bar) and 图 8-3 (training done, with "像你本人 xx%"). There is a tip that out-of-memory errors are retried automatically with half the batch size.
- 8.3: retitled "看懂训练方案和进度". It explains each part of the training plan line and lists the 8 progress steps. It includes a box on DPO: "自动" means off, because there is no reliable evidence it helps, GPT training gets 2–4× slower, and it needs about 22 GB of video memory. You turn it on in 高级设置 or with `voicetwin.bat train -v 我的声音 --dpo on`.
- 8.5: uses "像你本人（%）".
- 8.6: says old training runs are backed up to logs\vt_…\old_runs (last two kept). Re-training with unchanged material continues from last time.
- 8.7: the advanced-settings labels are copied exactly from app.py, including the DPO radio.

**Ch9 (generation)**
- 9.2: new settings table with 图 9-1. It covers the new 保存的文件名 and 保存格式 (WAV/MP3) fields, and notes that uploaded txt/md/docx text goes into the script box.
- 9.2 quality: a table of the five tiers (快速/均衡/最好/极致/完美). The default depends on video memory: 8 GB or more → 完美, less → 极致, no usable GPU → 均衡. The honest note is included.
- 9.2 speed: a subsection with 图 9-2 (left = faster, right = slower, ±30, recommend −15…+15, ▶ 试听语速 reads one sentence with 快速, only speed changes).
- 9.3: progress bar (图 9-3), done screen (图 9-4) and downloads (图 9-5). A box states that the output contains only your voice, with no background or noise floor, and pauses are absolute digital silence.
- 9.4: explains how "像你本人（%）" is calibrated against your own recordings and the 85% rule, including the case where only the rough MFCC model is available. It shows the result table (图 9-6).
- New subsection in 9.4 for the 完美 tier's two versions (图 9-7): A 未去杂音 / B 去杂音, ⭐ 推荐, picking in 最终使用哪个版本 switches the player and the download, and both files are saved.
- 9.5 redo is updated; 9.6 gives the new file names and the 📂 / 📍 buttons; 9.7 uses the new tier names.

**Ch10–11**
- Ch10: pauses are now described as absolute silence whose lengths follow your habits; the old tier names and the old speed setting are replaced.
- 11.5: rewritten. It says the output is already clean, with silent pauses and loudness matched to your recordings, and that nothing needs adding — no room tone, background noise or EQ.
- Also fixed: the mux example file name, the 11.4 speed advice, and "三种常见用法" → "四种" (there are four cards).

**Ch12 (checking)**
- Retitled "检验效果：评估、鉴别与盲测".
- 12.1–12.2 cover ④ 试试像不像（可选） with 图 12-1 and the new score ranges.
- 12.3 is the new ⑤ machine check (图 12-2), with the comparison-experiment table moved into it.
- 12.4 is the built-in audience blind test (图 12-3), including grading answer cards collected offline, plus the accuracy table and caveats.
- 12.5: updated rows, plus one new honest row: completely silent pauses can sometimes give the audio away when it is compared closely with real recordings.

**Size:** 06_ch08_09.html grew from about 16 KB to 32 KB, mostly because chapters 8–9 went from 2 screenshots to 10 as requested; I cut some repeated text to compensate. 07_ch10_12.html grew from 32 KB to 37 KB.
open_questions: 08_ch13_15.html (not mine) may still call the field '指定参考音频 id'. The app now labels it '指定参考音频编号（留空 = 自动挑选）' and has moved it under '高级设置（一般不用改）'. My chapters use the new label, and section 13.2 may need the same change.
app.py's _source() shows that uploaded txt/md/docx files are now loaded into the 讲稿 box; only srt/vtt are kept as a file. Any other chapter that still says '上传了文件时以文件为准' is outdated.

In 12.5 I added a short honest row saying completely silent pauses might be noticed when compared closely with real recordings that have room noise. It recommends nothing to add. Remove it if the silence requirement means it should not be mentioned at all.

In 11.5 I kept a conditional note about background-music volume ('如果课程本身要配背景音乐…'). It is not advice to add room tone or background noise, but drop it if the rule against recommending 'background' is meant to cover music too.
Captions for 图 8-3, 9-4, 9-6, 9-7, 12-1 and 12-2 say the similarity numbers come from a demo voice or the rough MFCC model and are only examples.

problems_fixed: 06_ch08_09.html 8.2 step 1: the voice library label is now the exact app.py text '🎙️ 我的声音库（共 N 个）'. It was a shortened form.

06_ch08_09.html 9.2 quality table, 完美 row: added that cards under 8 GB stop at 12 tries instead of 20. This comes from QUALITY_PRESETS['perfect'].low_tier_max_candidates=12 and matches the existing note on the 极致 row.
06_ch08_09.html 9.3: the summary is now quoted as '✅ 生成好了：音频长 …，共 … 句'. It used to say '… 秒', but _fmt_duration prints 'X 分 Y 秒' once the audio is longer than a minute.
06_ch08_09.html 9.7 step 3: changed '用"完美"档正式生成（显卡正常时默认就是）' to '（显存 8 GB 以上时默认就是）'. A working card with less than 8 GB defaults to 极致 (recommended_quality / TIER_QUALITY).

07_ch10_12.html 12.2, 各声纹模型 row: the manual said the raw similarity is shown in brackets. The ④ card actually prints '像你本人（%）：81.1；原始相似度：0.806' with no brackets, so the text now says '后面的"原始相似度"（0~1）一般不用看'.
07_ch10_12.html 12.3: the default machine check now says it covers both versions and each sentence 'at most 20 sentences'. _report_audio_files caps this at max_clips=20.
07_ch10_12.html 12.4 step 5: added that every clip must be answered before 提交答案 works and that the choices lock after submitting. This is how on_blind_submit / _blind_missing behave.
07_ch10_12.html 11.5: the background-music tip no longer reads like advice to add something. It now starts with '如果课程视频里本来就有背景音乐，注意把音乐音量调低…'.
07_ch10_12.html 12.5, '停顿处特别安静' row: added '不需要另外加任何声音（11.5 节）' so the honest note about silence cannot be read as a reason to add room tone.
07_ch10_12.html 11.1 card C: removed '一般不容易察觉', which promised too much. It now says '剪好后自己先仔细听一遍衔接处（12.5 节）', consistent with the 12.5 note about silence.
remaining_concerns: Everything else checked out. All .ui/.btn/.tab texts appear in app.py or engine.py, except the 剪映 and Windows menu names (关闭原声, 复制文件地址, 导出, 开始创作, 打开方式, 文本, 本地字幕, 记事本). The training plan, steps, OOM retry, DPO, old_runs (keep 2), quality tiers, speed slider, two versions, verify/blind headers, CLI options and config keys all match the code. All 13 images exist, figures run 8-1..8-3, 9-1..9-7 and 12-1..12-3 in order, and both files parse with balanced tags. I looked at every screenshot and the captions match what is in them.

The app contradicts itself: the ④ evaluate card shows the reference line '<85% 不太像', but its headline uses pct_label (75–85% = 有点像). The manual follows pct_label and adds '低于 85% 就算不够像'. It would be cleaner to make the app consistent.
The 'pct' label '声音名称' is used as shorthand in 8.2, 9.3 and 12.1. The real dropdown label is '声音名称（新建请直接输入名字）'. The app's own messages also say 「声音名称」, so I kept the short form.
The 11.5 background-music tip is kept but reworded to cover only music already in the course video. Drop it entirely if the 'no background' rule is meant to cover music too.
The '📂 打开保存文件夹' and '📍 在文件夹里找到这个文件' buttons only show when the app runs on the same computer (visible=self.local). 9.6 does not say this; it only matters for the LAN/phone setup in 13.7.
The 8.4 training-time table is a rough estimate and is not backed by anything in the code.

update.summary:
I updated chapters 13–15 and the appendix of the manual from v0.1.3 to v0.1.6, editing both files in place. Labels were checked against voicetwin/webui/app.py, commands against cli.py, settings against default_config.yaml, and error and status wording against errors.py, launcher.py, engine.py, gpu.py and speaker.py. I did not build the PDF. I added no images: the relevant screenshots are already figures in Ch5 and Ch3, so I point to section numbers (5.2, 5.3, 3.6) rather than other chapters' figure numbers, which may change. All heading ids are unchanged. Two section titles changed: 13.5 is now "管理多个声音：我的声音库" and 15.2 is now "启动、网页界面和进度条"; the table of contents is generated at build time. The HTML parses with no unbalanced tags, and every quoted button, label and tab name appears in app.py.

**08_ch13_15.html**
- **Ch13:**
  - 13.1: tip 4 now recommends the 完美 tier, plus redoing sentences marked 低于 85%. Tip 2 points to 🔍 自动查找可能的错字. A new note explains the training plan is chosen automatically.
  - 13.2: the field is now 高级设置（一般不用改）→ 指定参考音频编号（留空 = 自动挑选）.
  - 13.3 settings table: rebuilt from default_config.yaml with only keys that really exist:
    - Generation: output_format (mp3 can add faint noise in silences), quality auto → perfect / max / balanced (affects the command line; the web page picks by GPU), speed, pauses (always absolute silence), cer_retry_threshold / max_retries (均衡 and 最好 only).
    - New similarity group: min_pct 85, filter auto, target_pct 99, models.
    - Material preparation: validation_count 20, proofcheck auto, filter: speaker_outlier.
    - GPT-SoVITS: version, sovits_save_every / gpt_save_every auto, if_dpo auto, aux_refs (3 for 极致 and 完美).
    - Also: a one-line restore command (init-config --force --gptsovits-root D:\GPT-SoVITS), and a note that people upgrading keep their old config.yaml, which may still say quality: balanced.
  - 13.5: rewritten around 🎙️ 我的声音库（共 N 个）, with its columns, click-to-select, ▶ 试听这个声音, 🔄 刷新声音列表, and the one-task-at-a-time rule.
  - 13.6: added the old_runs folder (last 2 training runs kept, about 1 GB each), the two version files, and the new saved-model file names.
  - 13.7: the network command only works after closing the desktop instance; otherwise it just opens the existing local-only page. If 7860 is busy the port changes automatically.
